title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Siddharth helps Nalani with her hostel fees, bringing them closer. Kalamma secretly confronts Palani after spotting him at the police station, making Paraman suspicious.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
episodeTitle: Vetri Keeps His Word to Sudar
description: Vetri is upset over missing the murderer, but Divya calms him. After strategising with Prabhakaran to find Manickam, Vetri reassures Sudar as she cares for him.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Rasathi and Sudalai trick Manjamalai into attending the wedding without Poongodi. When Poongodi refuses to attend, the family panics, and an anxious Azhagar questions Suna Pana.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Gayathri and Chezhiyan's wedding takes place happily as they receive their parents' heartfelt blessings. Later, Annapurani bravely stops Sneha's deadly attempt to attack Sindhu.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Ragavan and Lakshmi fear their failing health. Later, Mathi slams Thangaraj for making her jobless and vows to rise above his influence.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Karthikeyan's proposal to marry Arasi leaves Pandian and Saravanan stunned. The doctor's revelation of Raji's pregnancy test results shocks her family.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha's call shocks Cheran as she reveals that her parents have arranged her marriage. He decides to bring Chandayatha back before her wedding takes place.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Arun sincerely pleads with Seetha to return home with him. The family is left shocked when Nachiyar arrives at Annamalai's home but fails to recognise Meena and Shruthi.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi's family rejoices as Azhagar topples around. Shaken by a bad dream, Sethupathi confides in Karuppu, who defends Aishwarya's efforts for the kids.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Madhu lashes out at Saranya about Arjun's behaviour at the wedding. Meanwhile, Kasthuri tells Karthik that she loves someone else, but Maran behaves improperly towards her.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Ganesan clears Kandhasamy's misunderstanding about Indhira and gains his consent for Murugan's marriage to her. Murugan accompanies Indhira to pick up her siblings from school.
